High-Protein Crispy Chicken Nuggets

Seasoned chicken-breast nuggets with a crisp air-fried coating, plus an optional quick hot-honey dip.

Prep
Not listed
Cook
Not listed
Total
30 min
Difficulty
Not listed
Ingredients
7

Ingredients

  • 500 g lean ground chicken or chicken breast, finely minced
  • 2 large eggs, divided
  • 1 tsp each garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, salt and black pepper
  • ½ tsp cayenne pepper
  • 100 g plain flour (creator tracks about 40 g consumed), plus seasonings to coat
  • Cooking-oil spray
  • Optional dip: 15 g butter, 3 tbsp hot sauce, 1 tbsp honey and chilli flakes

Original yield unavailable; scaling disabled.

Instructions

  1. If using chicken breast, pulse it in a food processor until finely minced. Mix with one egg and the garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, cayenne, salt and pepper.
  2. Shape into 20–22 small nuggets. Whisk the remaining seasonings into the flour in a shallow bowl; beat the second egg in another bowl.
  3. Coat each nugget in seasoned flour, dip in beaten egg, then return to flour for a light coating. Shake off excess.
  4. Arrange in a single layer in the air fryer. Spray with oil, cook at 400°F (200°C) for 12–15 minutes, turning and spraying again halfway through, until the center reaches 165°F (74°C).
  5. For oven baking, arrange on a lined tray and bake at 400°F (200°C) for about 25–30 minutes, turning once, until cooked through.
  6. For the optional dip, melt butter, stir in hot sauce and honey, then finish with chilli flakes.

Cook times may vary when changing batch size.
